The vault mints steakETH shares to `receiver`. The count comes from the vault's exchange rate in storage, rounded down, and has no minimum.
Before the conversion, the vault mints accrued performance-fee shares to the fee recipient. This lowers the share price the signer gets.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit", then the WETH amount, a fixed "Share ticker: steakETH" line and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many steakETH shares the receiver gets; the vault's exchange rate sets the count.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` and `_accrueFee()` mints fee shares first. The screen only has 'Share ticker: steakETH'. Case 0: the signer receives 252436277349273 steakETH and no screen field shows this amount.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show this, because ERC-4626 deposit has no minShares parameter.

findings.title: The deposit label 'Deposit asset' is on an amount, and 'Share ticker' is a constant, not a value the signer sends.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit: field `assets` has label 'Deposit asset' (tokenAmount). The next field is `{"label":"Share ticker","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"}`.
findings.fix: Rename it to 'Deposit amount'. Change the intent to 'Deposit WETH for steakETH shares'.

cases.notes: WETH out 0.00026 is shown right. steakETH in: the screen shows the asset and the receiver but not the amount (252436277349273 wei).

effects: The vault pulls WETH from the signer: the amount is convertToAssets(shares), rounded up, from the vault's exchange rate in storage, with no maximum in the calldata.
The vault mints exactly `shares` steakETH to `receiver`.
Before the conversion, the vault mints accrued performance-fee shares to the fee recipient. This raises the WETH cost.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", then 'Deposit asset: WETH' with no amount, the exact shares minted, and the share recipient.

findings.title: mint takes an amount of WETH from the signer that the screen does not show and nothing bounds.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);`. The screen shows 'Deposit asset: WETH' only. Case 1: the signer sends 1035214733 wei WETH and no screen field shows this amount.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the cost. ERC-4626 mint has no maxAssets parameter. A label such as 'Pay WETH (amount set by vault price)' can say so.

findings.title: The mint intent 'Mint' does not say that the signer pays WETH for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: `"intent": "Mint"`. The only sign of payment is the raw constant field 'Deposit asset' = 'WETH'. MetaMorpho.sol mint calls `_deposit(_msgSender(), ...)`, and this pulls WETH from the signer.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Deposit WETH to mint steakETH'. Rename 'Deposit asset' to 'Pay with'.

cases.notes: The screen names WETH as the asset that leaves but not its amount (1035214733 wei). The shares go to 0xdEaD, shown right, and are not an effect on the signer.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns steakETH shares from `owner`: the count is convertToShares(assets), rounded up, from storage, with no maximum.
When the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends the owner's share allowance to the signer.
The vault sends exactly `assets` WETH to `receiver`.
Before the conversion, the vault mints accrued performance-fee shares to the fee recipient. This raises the share count burned.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", then 'Withdraw exactly' with the WETH amount, the receiver ('To') and the share owner.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many steakETH shares the vault burns from the owner.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); ... _withdraw(_msgSender(), receiver, owner, assets, shares);`. Case 2: the vault burns 2038925100258679246874 steakETH from the signer and no screen field shows this amount.
findings.fix: No calldata value bounds the shares, because ERC-4626 withdraw has no maxShares parameter.

cases.notes: WETH in 2125 to the signer is shown right. steakETH out: the reader knew shares burn but saw no amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` steakETH from `owner`. When the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends the owner's share allowance.
The vault sends WETH to `receiver`: the amount is convertToAssets(shares), rounded down, from storage, with no minimum.
Before the conversion, the vault mints accrued performance-fee shares to the fee recipient. This lowers the WETH paid out.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", then the steakETH shares to redeem, the receiver ('To') and the share owner. No field names the asset received.

findings.title: The redeem screen never says that the receiver gets WETH. The mint format names WETH, but redeem does not.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem fields: only `shares`, `receiver`, `owner`. MetaMorpho.sol redeem calls `_withdraw(...)`, and this sends the underlying asset (WETH, constructor `_asset` 0xC02a...6Cc2) to receiver. Case 3: the signer receives 205992687195325 wei WETH. The reader was unsure whether ETH or WETH arrives.
findings.fix: Add a field `{"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}`. Change the intent to 'Redeem steakETH for WETH'.

findings.title: redeem does not show how much WETH the receiver gets; the vault's exchange rate sets it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 3: 205992687195325 wei WETH arrives and no screen field shows this amount.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show this, because ERC-4626 redeem has no minAssets parameter.

cases.notes: steakETH out 0.0002 is shown right. WETH in: the screen gives neither the asset nor the amount, so the reader guessed ETH or WETH.
